guides.prerequisites: Understand order state, units, timestamps, planned versus realized outcomes, and that fictional calculations are not trading instructions.
guides.procedure: Name the decision cutoff, inputs, units, formula or state transition; show every intermediate step; distinguish planned values from observed executions; stop when a required input is unavailable.
guides.workedCase: FICTIONAL: A 200-share order receives a 50-share fill, then cancel is requested; a later 30-share fill leaves 120 only after cancel confirmation.
guides.limit: Message ordering and venue acknowledgments must be preserved.
guides.invalidation: HOLD when timestamps, order state, units, source rights, or a required input cannot be verified. Message ordering and venue acknowledgments must be preserved.
guides.commonError: Live-trading misconception: Treating cancel-click time as the end of exposure can omit valid late fills. Correct by returning to the stated inputs, formula, order state, and evidence cutoff.
guides.selfCheck: Reproduce the fictional calculation or classification, correct the misconception, and name one condition that invalidates the result.
guides.reviewExplanation: Ungraded Talia walkthrough: A cancel request is not a confirmed cancellation; an execution may occur before the venue accepts the cancel. Worked fictional evidence: A 200-share order receives a 50-share fill, then cancel is requested; a later 30-share fill leaves 120 only after cancel confirmation. Error correction: Treating cancel-click time as the end of exposure can omit valid late fills. Boundary: Message ordering and venue acknowledgments must be preserved. No protected assessment, personalized order, or future outcome is created.
guides.transferQuestion: FICTIONAL independent transfer: Submitted 300, filled 100, cancel pending, then 40 fill: compute exposure before confirmation.

guides.title: Time-in-force boundary
guides.concept: Time in force controls order duration, not whether a valid price will be available.
guides.prerequisites: Understand order state, units, timestamps, planned versus realized outcomes, and that fictional calculations are not trading instructions.
guides.procedure: Name the decision cutoff, inputs, units, formula or state transition; show every intermediate step; distinguish planned values from observed executions; stop when a required input is unavailable.
guides.workedCase: FICTIONAL: A day limit remains eligible during its broker-defined session and expires unfilled with 0 of 100 shares executed.
guides.limit: Broker session definitions and extended-hours eligibility vary.
guides.invalidation: HOLD when timestamps, order state, units, source rights, or a required input cannot be verified. Broker session definitions and extended-hours eligibility vary.
guides.commonError: Live-trading misconception: Assuming DAY always includes extended hours ignores broker and venue rules. Correct by returning to the stated inputs, formula, order state, and evidence cutoff.
